create.name: Samatva Yoga
create.bio:
Samatva Yoga is an Ashtanga school on the island of Florianópolis in southern Brazil, founded in 2012 in Lagoa da Conceição by Ana Cláudia Lopes, known as Kaká. She had already taught Ashtanga for six years when she decided the island needed a school devoted to the method as it is taught in Mysore. She holds Level 2 authorisation from the Sharath Yoga Centre, has spent many seasons in India studying with R. Sharath Jois, and also studies Ayurveda, Vedic chanting and Vedanta. The school says it is the only one in Santa Catarina with teachers authorised by the Mysore institute.

The main shala in Lagoa da Conceição was joined by a second in the city centre in 2017 and a third, with a garden and café, in Novo Campeche in the south of the island in 2020. Mysore-style practice runs every weekday morning, noon and evening, with led classes on Saturdays, and beginners are welcome in every weekday session. Yin yoga and Sangraha, a contemporary approach developed by Eddie Stern, sit alongside Ashtanga.

Since 2021 Samatva has also taught online, with live daily practice and study programmes on meditation, pranayama, mantra, mythology and the Yoga Sutra, and it regularly hosts visiting senior Ashtanga teachers for week-long workshops.
